Legible white lettering on dark backing at bottom left, no clipping

must.item: Lower third doesn't cover face and remains stable/readable
must.why: Off face, but it vanishes by the end and the line is garbled.

must.item: Caption absent in opening second and present from ~1s to end
must.why: Caption is already visible at 0.7s and gone at 6.7s.

Caption missing at 6.7s, so it doesn't last to the end
